quote: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway at any time: When approaching the crest of a grade or upon a curve in the highway where the driver’s view is obstructed within such distance as to create a hazard in the event another vehicle might approach from the opposite direction. Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.

activation.description: Approaching a crest of grade or upon a curve with the stated obstructed view and possible opposite-direction approach.
activation.source_clause: When approaching the crest of a grade or upon a curve in the highway where the driver’s view is obstructed within such distance as to create a hazard

obligation.description: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway while the applicable condition holds.
obligation.source_clause: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway at any time

exceptions.source_clause: Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.

timing.description: Observe the full approach to the crest or traversal of the curve at every original frame.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: the driver’s view is obstructed within such distance as to create a hazard in the event another vehicle might approach from the opposite direction
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original sight rays, road geometry and possible opposite-direction approach require physical and legal review.
The subsection 3 exception requires original highway designation, not an authored map label.
